description: This Java class 'GeoServices' provides geographic utilities, specifically calculating the distance between two geographic points (latitude and longitude) using the Haversine formula. It is part of the OFBiz framework's common geo package.

classes.name: GeoServices
classes.description: A utility class offering methods related to geographic calculations, such as computing the distance between two points on Earth.

methods.name: getDistanceBetweenGeoPoints
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two geographic points specified by latitude and longitude, returning the distance in either kilometers or miles depending on the measurement system.
